sentiment.instructions: Classify the overall sentiment of the text. Base your judgment only on the attitude the text itself expresses, not on whether you agree with it or on whether the events it describes are good or bad.

criteria.positive: The author expresses a favorable attitude, even if only mildly.
criteria.neutral: The author expresses no attitude, as when merely reporting news or facts, even if those facts are pleasant or unpleasant.
criteria.negative: The author expresses an unfavorable attitude, even if only mildly.
